description: End-to-end NLP-driven test of the Netflix Android game play workflow.
steps: Launch the game and wait for 40 seconds to welcome screen to load
Tap on 'Start' which led you to Play Screen of game
wait for the Play screen to load
Tap the 'Play' and wait for the 'MONKEY MEADOW' screen
Tap the 'MONKEY MEADOW' and wait for next 'EASY' screen
Tap the 'EASY' and wait for next 'STANDARD' screen
Tap right facing tilt triangle four times in interval of one second gap
